# GOV.UK

> The official UK government portal providing comprehensive access to public services, benefits, information, and guidance for citizens, businesses, and employers.

GOV.UK is the primary digital gateway for UK government services, organizing information into 15+ major life and work categories. The site covers everything from benefits and taxation to immigration, education, housing, and employment, serving millions of users seeking official government guidance and service access.

## Key Topics

- Universal Credit
- HMRC
- State Pension
- Self Assessment
- National Insurance
- Child Benefit
- Jobseeker's Allowance
- Employment and Support Allowance
- MOT
- Lasting Power of Attorney
- Equality Act
- Tax-Free Childcare
- financial-support
- life-events
- apprenticeships

## Core Gateway

- [Welcome to GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk): GOV.UK homepage: gateway to government services, benefits, and information
- [Services and information - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse): Service directory and category hub for all GOV.UK government services

## Money, Tax and Pensions

- [Money and tax - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/tax): Tax hub: income tax, Self Assessment, Personal Tax Account and HMRC services
- [Benefits - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/benefits): Benefits hub: Universal Credit, allowances, tax credits and welfare support
- [Working, jobs and pensions - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/working): Work hub: jobs, pensions, State Pension, redundancy and workplace rights

## Family, Childcare and Life Events

- [Childcare and parenting - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/childcare-parenting): Childcare hub: pregnancy, adoption, schools, child benefits and support
- [Births, deaths, marriages and care - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/births-deaths-marriages): Life events hub: parenting, marriage, divorce, power of attorney services

## Travel, Visas and Immigration

- [Visas and immigration - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/visas-immigration): Immigration hub: visas, eVisas, ETA, asylum and UK entry requirements
- [Passports, travel and living abroad - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/abroad): Travel hub: passports, visas, travel advice and living abroad services
- [Citizenship and living in the UK - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/citizenship): Citizenship hub: voting, immigration, Life in the UK test and residency

## Business, Employment and Transport

- [Business and self-employed - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/business): Business hub: tax guidance, registration, compliance and self-employment
- [Employing people - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/employing-people): Employer hub: payroll, recruitment, contracts, rights and compliance
- [Driving and transport - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/driving): Driving hub: MOT, vehicle tax, licenses, registration and transport services

## Health, Housing and Environment

- [Disabled people - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/disabilities): Disability hub: benefits, rights, carers support and Equality Act guidance
- [Housing and local services - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/housing-local-services): Housing hub: renting, buying, council tax, planning and local services
- [Environment and countryside - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/environment-countryside): Environment hub: flooding, recycling, farming, wildlife and land management

## Education, Justice and Government

- [Education and learning - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/education): Education hub: student finance, loans, admissions and apprenticeships
- [Crime, justice and the law - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/justice): Justice hub: crime reporting, courts, legal processes and victim support
- [Departments, agencies and public bodies - GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/government/organisations): Government directory: UK departments, agencies and public bodies

## Optional

- [Cookies on GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/help/cookies): Cookie policy and tracking settings for GOV.UK service
